adjudication_basis: Local MuJoCo proxy trace reached the configured 0.30 m goal tolerance (final recorded goal distance 0.2371 m).
Local runner recorded Nav2 result status code 4 (SUCCEEDED), no collision/contact, no map violation, and no timeout.
The matching Jetson FollowPath action result independently records status succeeded and result status 4 for the same scene and reverse path.
Runtime bridge health reported last_goal_status_code 4 after the action became inactive.
decision_rule: A fixed-only traversal passes when the scene/path identity matches, the Nav2 FollowPath action reaches SUCCEEDED, the local proxy reaches goal tolerance, and collision/contact, map_violation, and timeout are all false.
scope: One reverse traversal in one isolated static-obstacle scene using a local D1 Max kinematic MuJoCo proxy and Jetson ROS 2 Foxy Nav2 controller; not hardware or pedestrian evidence.
